split.requirement: [61] Existing fixed-guide widget remains safe alongside adaptive planning (the widget half of 「Existing fixed-guide widget and progress must remain safe」)
split.label: 3.1.0 所有者要求
split.evidence: The owner asked to drop the old entry completely and cut ties with the old project (docs/DESIGN_v3.md §19; spec docs/specs/SPEC_3.1.0.md §1.3), which supersedes this half. 3.1.0 no longer carries the 3.0.x copy of the guide: its activity, its home-screen widget 「P3R 逐日攻略」 (PlannerWidget, planner_widget_info.xml), assets and tests are gone, and WidgetUpgradeReceiverTest.theManifestDeclaresOnlyThePlannersComponents asserts that the manifest declares only the planner's activities, the plan widget and the v3 upgrade receiver. The guide's data stays as pinned sources under rules/sources/cn_guides/.
split.gap: An old 「P3R 逐日攻略」 widget on the home screen stops working after the update to 3.1.0; docs/RELEASE_NOTES_3.1.0.md and README.md (下载) tell players to remove it (「P3R 每日安排」 is not affected). The 2.0.0 app (app.p3r.dayplanner.test) is a separate package; its guide widget is untouched.

split.requirement: [61] Existing fixed-guide progress remains safe alongside adaptive planning (the progress half)
split.label: 3.1.0 之后：旧攻略进度可导出
split.evidence: 3.1.0 keeps the 3.0.x guide's progress on the phone: the prefs p3r_native_progress_v1 are never written or deleted (owner decision O2). After 3.1.0, 我的 → 备份与恢复 exports them as the old page's file: a section 「旧版逐日攻略」 with the button 「导出打勾进度」, shown only when a task is ticked (BackupPage.showOldGuide, exportOldGuideTo; OldGuideProgress). OldGuideProgress.read uses getAll() only, never an editor, off the main thread. The button saves through ACTION_CREATE_DOCUMENT, application/json, default name P3R_打卡进度.json (result handled in HomeActivity.onActivityResult). The file is what the old page's exportProgress() wrote, JSON.stringify({format: 'p3r_hunterjia_checklist_v1', completed, completedSubsteps, schemaVersion: 2, exportedAt}, null, 2) (OldGuideProgress.toJson), with completed from the prefs' 'completed' and completedSubsteps from 'substeps'. The 2.0.0 app's guide imports that format: the handoff zip P3R_Planner_Handoff_20261013.zip holds its page, source/android/app/src/main/assets/index.html, whose sha256 aa0d1ad3… matches docs/handoff/SOURCE_SHA256.json; its importProgress (line 435) accepts an object whose completed is an object and whose format, if present, is p3r_hunterjia_checklist_v1; and the zip's data.json and the 3.0.x data.json (rules/sources/cn_guides/data.json) have the same 691 ids. (The zip's build files say 2.0.1 / code 11, while docs/handoff/RELEASE_2_0_0.md describes 2.0.0 / code 10; the page in the zip is dated before that checkpoint note.) OldGuideExportTest (all pass in the full run): withoutATickedTaskThereIsNoEntry (looking creates no prefs file either); tickedTasksShowTheEntryWithTheirCount (a card with a button; render qa_out/v3/ui/home_backup_old_guide.png); exportSavesTheOldPagesFileAndLeavesThePrefsAlone (the save intent; saved bytes equal the old page's output, generated by running that expression in Node over the same stored text; the prefs' keys, values and file bytes are unchanged); theFileIsWhatJsonStringifyWrites (key order, escapes, numbers); brokenStoredTextNeverCrashes; aFailedSaveSaysSoAndACancelWritesNothing; ticksGoneBeforeTheSaveSaySo; anEmptyDocumentLeftByAFailedSaveIsRemoved.
split.gap: The published 3.1.0 APK does not have the export; it comes with the next update. Until then the ticks stay on the phone (O2), and a player still on 3.0.x can export them before updating from the guide's own menu (「设置」 → 「导出进度备份」). docs/RELEASE_NOTES_3.1.0.md (with a note added after the release), README.md (下载) and docs/DESIGN_v3.md §19 say so. Only the prefs are read, not the 3.0.x WebView storage; that page mirrored every tick into the prefs (syncState), and its widget wrote there directly. Numbers in the file match the old page's for what 3.0.x stored (booleans), not for every double. This check did not run the system file picker on a device, and it did not import into an installed 2.0.0 app; the format is checked against the old page's own export expression and its import function.
